<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Health and environment
*In the aftermath of [[Cyclone Idai]], those infected by [[cholera]] jump to 139 confirmed cases in [[Mozambique]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/mozambique-cholera-cases-jump-to-139-a-day-after-outbreak/2019/03/29/ad9b3f88-51f3-11e9-bdb7-44f948cc0605_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.ae94c14a8c3f (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/cyclone-mozambique-cholera-outbreak-water-disease-red-cross-ticking-time-bomb/ (CBS News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Same-sex marriage in the Cayman Islands]]
**[[Cayman Islands]] legalises [[same-sex marriage]] after a judge rules that a law defining marriage as a relationship between a man and woman is [[Constitution of the Cayman Islands|unconstitutional]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/cayman-islands-gay-marriage-same-sex-lgbt-british-territory-a8846431.html (''The Independent'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] suffers another defeat of 286–344 on her Withdrawal Agreement. [[President of the European Council|European Council President]] [[Donald Tusk]] schedules an emergency summit on April 10, two days before [[Brexit]] is scheduled to happen. [https://edition.cnn.com/uk/live-news/brexit-withdrawal-deal-vote-gbr-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Algerian protests]]
**Algerians protest in the capital of [[Algiers]] against President [[Abdelaziz Bouteflika]] in an effort to make him resign. It is estimated that tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands attended. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/29/world/africa/algeria-antigovernment-protests.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47746938 (BBC)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/huge-rallies-in-algiers-despite-loyalist-calls-for-president-to-11393902 (Channel NewsAsia)]
